data.title: SCYNEXIS Buy Rating Reaffirmed as Advancing Antifungal Pipeline and BARDA Support Underpin Unchanged $32 Price Target
data.description:
In a report released yesterday, Jason McCarthy from Maxim Group maintained a Buy rating on SCYNEXIS, with a price target of $32.00.

Jason McCarthy has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to SCYNEXIS’s advancing antifungal pipeline and de-risked clinical profile. He views the positive Phase 1 data for SCY-247’s IV formulation as a pivotal milestone, since it enables both IV and oral versions to move into Phase 2 for invasive candidiasis with target drug exposures already achieved and a clean tolerability profile. The ability to offer both IV and oral formulations, including oral step-down therapy, is seen as a competitive advantage in a field with few effective options and rising resistance to existing azole antifungals.

McCarthy also emphasizes that SCYNEXIS is developing SCY-247 in a novel triterpenoid class with broad, fungicidal activity, building on the company’s track record from ibrexafungerp, which was licensed to GSK and has late-stage data in serious fungal infections. His conviction is strengthened by the BARDA contract of up to roughly $214 million, which materially supports SCY-247’s development and validates the strategic importance of the program. He further notes the company’s solid cash position and additional pipeline asset SCY-770 in ADPKD as incremental drivers, leading him to maintain an unchanged price target of $32 and a Buy rating on the stock.

data.title: Roche Collaboration and Royalty-Focused Model Drive Higher Zymeworks Valuation, Supporting Buy Rating
data.description:
Analyst Akash Tewari of Jefferies maintained a Buy rating on Zymeworks, with a price target of $52.00.

Akash Tewari has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Zymeworks’ evolving royalty-focused business model and newly signed Roche collaboration. The ZW209 deal brings meaningful non-dilutive funding through upfront and near-term payments, sizeable milestone potential, and a tiered royalty stream, which he views as materially accretive to Zymeworks’ net present value and supports a higher price target.

Akash Tewari’s rating is based on the view that this Roche transaction validates Zymeworks’ R&D capabilities while offloading major development risk to a large-cap partner, complementing existing royalty upside from Ziihera and additional milestones in first-line HER2-positive gastric cancer. He also highlights further optionality from the J&J pasritamig agreement, upcoming data from ZW251 and ZW191, and ongoing share repurchases, collectively reinforcing his constructive stance and underpinning the Buy recommendation.

data.title: Alimentation Couche-Tard: Core+More Strategy, Zabka Acquisition, and FY28 Earnings Power Support Buy Rating and C$101 Target Price
data.description:
Desjardins analyst Chris Li CFA has maintained their bullish stance on ATD stock, giving a Buy rating on October 19.

Chris Li CFA has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Alimentation Couche-Tard’s resilient performance and strategic initiatives. Despite softer macro conditions pressuring convenience and fuel volumes, he expects solid execution of the Core+More strategy to sustain growth in higher-margin categories such as food, alternative nicotine and energy drinks, while fuel margins remain structurally elevated.

Looking ahead, he sees improving economic indicators supporting a return of U.S. merchandise same-store sales growth to the 2–3% range and views the upcoming Zabka acquisition as a meaningful earnings catalyst once synergies are detailed and realized. Together with disciplined capital allocation, ongoing share repurchases and a valuation based on robust FY28 earnings power, these drivers underpin his C$101 target price and support a continued Buy recommendation on ATD.
